title: Practice 2: Adverbs of place, time and manner

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does от- add in отны́не?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists отны́не under this meaning of от-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).

exercises.q: What does от- add in о́троду?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists о́троду under this meaning of от-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: from within, from the inside, from inside, out of
(colloquial) never, for the whole life (since birth till present)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: извне́ — from the outside, from outside; изнутри́ — from within, from the inside, from inside, out of; отны́не — henceforth, henceforward, from now on; о́троду — (colloquial) never, for the whole life (since birth till present).

exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists отовсю́ду under this meaning of от-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).

exercises.q: What does до- add in досыта?
options: adding to what there was before
fullness, being brought to the utmost degree
completing an action, reaching a goal
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists досыта under this meaning of до-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «до-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/до-).
